item.title: Who would be Queen of Hawai’i today?
item.description: The Kingdom of Hawaiʻi existed between 1795 and 1893. It was established by Kamehameha I, who ruled the island of Hawai’i, when he conquered the islands of Oʻahu, Maui, Molokaʻi, and Lānaʻi. The islands of Kauaʻi and Niʻihau voluntarily joined the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
